messages:
sam.k: Quick follow-up from the autoscaler sync — I think we should separate 'sustained reservations' from 'instant burst' logic. Current reactive-only approach keeps oscillating and hurts tail latency.

maya: Agree. We've seen tenants with steady 30% higher qps for ~12m, scaler tears down in between and churn kills cache locality.

tj: Do you mean a separate long-window estimator that converts repeated peaks into reservations?

sam.k: Yeah. Two-window model: short window (30s-2m) for burst admission; long window (10-20m) to convert to soft reservations. Reservations get prewarm and KV persistence.

oliver: Concern: reservations increase cost if we mis-predict. Need a cooldown and decay (e.g., reservation credit drains).

rana: We already have tenant credit abstraction for burst lanes. Can we piggyback on that for reservation amortization?

maya: Maybe. Proposal: when long-window avg > threshold T for W minutes, allocate reservation with X-min guaranteed lifetime and consume from a 'sustained budget'. If budget exhausted, downgrade to best-effort.

sam.k: Sketch of policy config (proto style):
```
policy: {
  short_window_secs: 60
  short_threshold_rps: 20
  long_window_secs: 900
  long_threshold_rps: 10
  reservation_min_lifetime_secs: 600
  reservation_decay_rate_per_min: 0.05
}
```

tj: That looks reasonable. How do we surface this in Dedicated config? Tenant-level flags or pool-level?

oliver: Prefer pool-level defaults + tenant overrides. Enterprise customers can bump long_threshold or min_lifetime.

rana: Edge case: autoscaler decision loop must be idempotent when multiple controllers operate. Need a reservation lease object in control-plane (small CRD).

sam.k: Good call. Create a lightweight Reservation CR with owner, capacity, expiry, budget_token_ref. Controller reconciles.

maya: Also add a failopen: if control-plane is partitioned, fall back to short-window bursts only (no new reservations). Keep existing reservations until expiry.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: autoscaler/reservations-controller v0.3 -> staging at 2026-03-20T10:12:00Z :rocket:

tj: For metrics: emit reservation_create, reservation_extend, reservation_expire, reservation_reject (reason). Also reservation_cost_estimate to help billing.

rana: Action items: 1) I will draft a small RFC covering API (Reservation CR), policy fields, and fallback semantics. 2) @oliver and @tj will prototype the estimator. 3) @maya and I will write integration tests for cache warmup behavior.

sam.k: Timeline: RFC by EOD Thu, prototype POC next week, alpha in staging in 2 sprints. If nobody objects, I'll file the RFC now.

maya: +1

oliver: +1

tj: +1

rana: +1

sam.k: OK filing RFC: https://rdrw.internal/rfcs/987-reservation-long-window (draft)

maya: one more note: document the UX in Console — show active reservations + decay progress, and provide a manual 'pin' to convert reservation into committed capacity for billing.

sam.k: Nice. That should keep infra and product happy. We'll iterate on thresholds with load tests.

oliver: Cool. End-to-end checklist in the RFC would help.

sam.k: Will do — thanks everyone.
